Hi Jonas / Laura,

Attached are MedSuite's redlines to the security exhibit and the proposed language for audit rights on the MSA and Order Form. High level items we'd like to confirm before legal exchange:

- Pen test clause: we request the right to commission a third-party pen test of the service (OWASP Top 10 + auth/privilege escalation), with a 30-day notice and a copy of the executive summary + remediation plan.
- Audit rights / scope: limited to evidence collection related to our data (logs, configuration, controls). On-site access should be available only if remote evidence is insufficient; prefer to avoid broad, unrestricted on-site access.
- SOC 2: we'd like to receive the latest SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter; please confirm cadence and how soon after signing you can provide the report.
- Evidence cadence & retention: weekly access log extracts for the prior 90 days and full audit log retention for 12 months.
- Encryption & keys: confirmation of encryption in transit and at rest (AES-256) and key management options (KMS).

We included a redlined doc (medsuite_security_redlines.docx) and PDF of the exhibit. Please advise whether Redwood can accept the pen test and audit language as redlined, or propose alternative carve-outs. We are on a compressed procurement timeline and would like to finalize these items this week.

Thanks,

Elena / Jonas,

Thanks — I reviewed MedSuite's redlines and have proposed a compromise that should address MedSuite's risk concerns while preserving Redwood's operational constraints. High-level position below and I've inserted inline redline suggestions in the Drive doc.

1) Audit rights / scope
- Redwood can permit customer-initiated audits limited to collection of customer-specific evidence reasonably necessary to assess the controls protecting MedSuite's data.
- On-site access: allowed only if remote evidence (logs, reports, configuration exports) is demonstrably insufficient. On-site visits must be scheduled with at least 30 days' notice and mutually agreed scope; Redwood will not accept open-ended or unfettered on-site access.

2) Pen testing
- Redwood will accept customer-authorized pen tests executed by an agreed third party. MedSuite must provide (a) the proposed test scope in advance, (b) a test window with at least 30 days' notice, and (c) an executive summary and remediation plan.
- Redwood requests a 30-day remediation period following delivery of critical findings before any enforcement remedies; for critical/high findings we will commit to an aggressive remediation plan (target: 90 days for critical issues) with status updates.

3) SOC 2
- Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter where applicable. SOC 2 reports are produced annually; we can make the current report available on execution and will provide reasonable updates for critical regressions.

4) Evidence cadence & retention
- Redwood will provide weekly access log extracts for operational review for the prior 90 days upon request and will retain full audit logs for 12 months. Any automated exports will be delivered via secure Share (SFTP/secure Drive link).

5) Encryption & KMS
- Confirmed: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.2+ in transit. We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integrations for certain Dedicated/Private deployments — we'll confirm options depending on the agreed deployment model in the Order Form.

If MedSuite is comfortable with the above, we will produce a clean redline back to your document and request DocuSign for the amended Order Form. Otherwise please call out the specific items you'd like to negotiate further.

Regards,
Laura Bennett

- Pen test scope: we need the test to include OWASP Top 10, privilege escalation, and identity/auth flows. We can supply a short scope doc (attached: medsuite_pen-test-outline.pdf).
- Remediation timeline: 30 days notice for scheduling is fine. For critical findings we need a written remediation plan and target remediation within 90 days; if remediation exceeds 90 days we want quarterly status updates until closure.
- SOC 2 timing: we need confirmation that the SOC 2 Type II report will be made available upon signature and that Redwood will provide a 3rd-party attestation/bridge letter if the report is older than 6 months.
- Logs & retention: 12 months retention is acceptable; please confirm the mechanism for secure transfer (SFTP or pre-authorized Drive link).
